column1: # Phase 2.22 ray geometry audit (model m15_2p82d, ND=70, NC=15, NP=85)

# NI_SMALL = number of model shells crossed = 86-LS; NI_RAY >= NI_SMALL (Doppler inserts).
# Flagged/argmax cells are all at the rays' OUTER-ENTRY points (I=1..5, model depths 1-5).

# V=48.9-50.5 km/s ~ VTURB=50 km/s, sigma=-1.04..-1.18 (marginal compression),
